items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 西风骑士团，「火花骑士」，可莉，前来报到！…呃——后面该说什么词来着？可莉背不下来啦…
items.text_en: Spark Knight Klee of the Knights of Favonius, reporting for duty! ...There's some more, but uh, I forgot. I'm not so good at remembering...

items.title: 闲聊·收获
items.text: 可莉今天又勇敢地抓到了花纹奇怪的蜥蜴！从没见过这种图案，你要看看吗？
items.text_en: Klee was a brave girl today! I found a really weird-looking lizard! Want me to show it to you?

items.title: 闲聊·冒险
items.text: 要和可莉一起去炸鱼吗？虽然被抓住就是一整天的禁闭，但鱼很好吃，所以值得！
items.text_en: Do you wanna come fish blasting with me? I'll get grounded for a whole day, but it's way worth it coz the fish taste sooo goood!

items.title: 闲聊·守则
items.text: 「城里放炮禁闭室报到」、「炸弹伤人琴找上门」、「放火烧山可莉完蛋」——这就是可莉在骑士团的生存守则。
items.text_en: "Explosion inside city wall, grounded be thy woe," "Explosions can hurt people, Jean can be dreadful," "Mondstadt be bombed, Klee be doomed." Those're the survival rules that the Knights of Favonius gave me.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 哼哼哼，这次的炸弹可是防水的。
items.text_en: Mwuhahaha, lucky all my new bombs are waterproof!

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 啊！什么东西爆炸了？！…哦，是打雷啊。
items.text_en: What'd I blow up!? ...Oh wait, it's just thunder and lightning. Phew.

items.title: 刮大风了
items.text: 风神保佑，把可莉的炸弹往合适的地方吹吧。
items.text_en: Dear Anemo God, please make Klee's bombs blow in the right direction and only blow up bad guys. The end.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早安！带可莉出去玩吧！我们一起来冒险！
items.text_en: Good morning! Can I come play with you today? Pleeeease? I wanna go on an adventure!

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 午饭时间到了！啊…吃什么呢？我来看看《提瓦特游览指南》…
items.text_en: Lunchtime! What do you wanna eat today? Let me see if the Teyvat Travel Guide has any suggestions...

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 晚上好！拜托你也帮我跟霍夫曼先生说说吧，可莉不是小孩子了，可莉晚上也可以出去玩——带我出去玩——
items.text_en: Good evening! Can you please tell Huffman that Klee is not a baby and is definitely allowed out to play at night? Please take me out to play together!

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 虽然出来玩的时候说不想回家，但天黑以后的旷野，不认识路…拜、拜托你回去的时候，把我也送回家好不好…
items.text_en: Hey... Um... I know I said I don't wanna go home and all, but now it's nighttime and I can't find my way home in the dark... Can you please take me home on your way back? Pleeeease?

items.title: 关于可莉自己·肇事
items.text: 呜…这次居然炸歪了大风车的叶片…真对不起！
items.text_en: Ohhhhh... I broke one of the blades on the windmill— I'm really sorry!

items.title: 关于可莉自己·赔偿
items.text: 我，我还挺会做手工的，请让我帮你们重新做一个…什么？禁止雇佣童工？呜…
items.text_en: I'm really good at fixing things though. I can help! Huh? What do you mean that's child labor? What even is child labor? Does that mean I can't help?

items.title: 关于我们·骑士
items.text: 呼呼…荣誉骑士，可莉作为「火花骑士」，可以说是你在西风骑士团的前辈喔？所以！所以…这次我闯的祸，能不能帮我隐瞒一下…
items.text_en: Complete "For a Tomorrow Without Tears"Hee-hee, you're an Honorary Knight but I've been a Spark Knight longer... That means I'm higher up than you, right? So you have to do what I say! So, um... Ca—Can you not say anything about the big disaster I caused? It was an accident...

items.title: 关于我们·玩伴
items.text: 不行！才九点，可莉今晚一定要撑到看完马戏团的午夜专场！你是可莉的玩伴吧！那就别想现在就把我送回家，略略略略…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6No! It's only nine o'clock, I'm staying up to watch the circus' special midnight performance! You're supposed to be my best friend! Don't even think about trying to send me home!

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 这个小小的玻璃球，就代表了巴巴托斯大人对可莉的肯定吗…唔…究竟是认可了我的哪一部分呢？是自由吗？那以后要不要更自由地出去炸鱼，来回应巴巴托斯大人的期待呢…？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4This little marble is supposed to be a present from Barbatos to say well done? Well done for what though? ...Hmm, he is the god of freedom I guess, maybe that's why he likes me? Alright, from now on I'll say thank you to Barbatos by showing that I have the freedom to blow up as many fish as I want! ...Am I doing it right?

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 可莉知道，骑士团的墙是不能炸的。虽然打通了能从禁闭室出去很方便，但凯亚哥哥说，这样做了以后，琴团长恐怕会让我再也见不到第二天的太阳…
items.text_en: At the Knights of Favonius building, you're not allowed to blow up the walls. Shame, it would make getting out of solitary confinement way easier... but if I did so much as try to blow up the wall, Jean would make sure Klee never sees the light of day again. That's what Jean said, Kaeya told me.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 每一只蜥蜴的花纹都是不同的，有些蜥蜴的尾巴干燥以后磨成粉，可以当做炸药的材料哦。这是阿贝多哥哥告诉我的事。
items.text_en: Every lizard has a different pattern on his back, and some of them you can use their dried-out tails to make gunpowder with. I know because Albedo told me so.

items.title: 关于雷泽
items.text: 我们是朋友！雷泽努力对抗危机、保护可莉的样子，让人安心！…唔…虽然基本上都是我把危机带到他身边的…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Razor's one of my best buddies! Whenever a disaster happens, he always knows the best way to fix it and helps keep Klee safe. Um, but most of the time I'm the one who caused the disaster...

items.title: 关于父母
items.text: 爸爸和妈妈都是全大陆有名的旅行家！妈妈写的《提瓦特游览指南》，有好多餐馆和旅店都很在意它的权威评价呢。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4My mom and dad are the famousest travelers in Teyvat! Mom writes the Teyvat Travel Guide, so all the restaurants and hotels in the whole world care what she thinks about them.

items.title: 关于凯亚
items.text: 凯亚哥哥是好人！《骑士团生存守则》就是凯亚哥哥帮可莉写的。可莉闯祸的时候，他也经常帮忙遮掩呢。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Kaeya is the best! He wrote the Favonius Survival Rulebook for me and he always helps me cover it up when I make a big disaster.

items.title: 关于安柏
items.text: 安柏姐姐是好人！兔兔伯爵摸起来也是毛茸茸的，而且还会爆炸，太棒了！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Amber is the best! Baron Bunny is so fluffy and he even explodes! So. Cool.

items.title: 关于琴
items.text: 琴团长是好人！虽然…有点可怕…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Master Jean is the best! But she's also a little bit scary.

items.title: 关于迪卢克
items.text: 奇怪的大人，一直都是不太开心的样子。唔…为什么不喜欢笑呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4He's one of the weird grown-ups. He's so grumpy all the time... Why does he never smile?

items.title: 关于丽莎
items.text: 丽莎阿…丽莎姐姐是好人！每次可莉靠近她的工坊，她就会给可莉好吃的茶点…欸？说起来我想进她的工坊，好像一开始是想做新的炸药来着…？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Lisa is the best! She always sneaks me some treats when I visit her at the workshop. ...Huh, I just remembered I was gonna ask her if I could use the workshop to make some new gunpowder. But I totally forgot...

items.title: 关于班尼特
items.text: 班尼特哥哥是好人！和他一起冒险，可莉总能有更多收获！…虽然班尼特哥哥自己总是什么宝物都找不到，嗯…这是为什么呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Bennett is the best! I always find way more treasure if I go adventuring with Bennett! ...But he never finds any. Why is that, anyway?

items.title: 关于迪奥娜
items.text: 迪奥娜姐姐是好人！「靠一己之力摧毁蒙德酒业」的想法好有趣，可莉也要用炸弹来帮忙！——呃，虽然不太懂什么叫做「蒙德酒业」，是怪物吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Diona is the best! I like listening to her, last time I heard her say, "I'm gonna destroy the wine industry in this city if it's the last thing I do!" And I'm gonna help her using my bombs! ...I don't know what a wine industry is though. Is it a monster?

items.title: 关于阿贝多
items.text: 阿贝多哥哥跟可莉有个秘密的约定！要是可莉看到工坊门前挂着「实验进行中」的牌子，就要晚点再去找他。阿贝多哥哥不工作的时候，会很耐心地陪着可莉，所以可莉也会很耐心地等着的！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Me and Albedo have a secret code! Whenever he puts a sign on his workshop door saying "Experiment in Progress," that's code for "Come Back Later, Klee." Albedo's really nice and he's so patient with me, so I don't mind waiting until he's finished with his work.

items.title: 关于莫娜
items.text: 莫娜姐姐是好人！她每次找阿贝多哥哥和可莉玩的时候，都会说好多听不明白，但是很有趣的东西！可莉喜欢她来玩！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Mona is the best! It's so much fun when she comes to play with me and Albedo. She talks about all these amazing things, and I don't understand most of it but... Ah, I just love it when Mona comes round!

items.title: 关于砂糖
items.text: 砂糖姐姐是好人！她问我，想不想要一个会跑会跳的蹦蹦！嘿嘿嘿，当然想要了，我还想要好几百个，让蒙德的街道上，台阶上，广场上，全是蹦蹦！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Sucrose is the best! This one time she asked me if I wanted a Jumpy Dumpty that can run as well as jump. Tee-hee, well duh! Of course I do, I want hundreds of them! I wanna put them on every street, every staircase, and every square in Mondstadt!

items.title: 想要了解可莉·其一
items.text: 你好！你是来找可莉玩的吗？
items.text_en: Hello, are you here for playtime with Klee?

items.title: 想要了解可莉·其二
items.text: 是啊，这个炸弹是可莉最新改良的作品！你看我做得好不好？…呃——如果是在什么纵火现场发现的话，那就不是我做的，绝对不是。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3Yeah! This is my new and improved bomb! Whaddya think? Great huh? ...Oh, but ahh... If you find it near any fires, it's not mine. Definitely. Not. Mine.

items.title: 想要了解可莉·其三
items.text: 哎，虽然新炸药的配方，很多都是在被关禁闭的时候想出来的…但如果不被关禁闭的话就更好了…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Sure, time in solitary confinement gives lots of time to think about new gunpowder formulas... But it'd still be better to not be in solitary in the first place.

items.title: 想要了解可莉·其四
items.text: 这是嘟嘟可，是可莉很久以前就交到的好朋友。要记得它的名字哦，以后别叫它「挂在你包上的玩偶」啦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5This is Dodoco, my oldest and bestest friend! Okay, now I've introduced you, don't forget her name again alright? No more calling Dodoco "that silly doll Klee always hangs on her rucksack."

items.title: 想要了解可莉·其五
items.text: 谢谢你总是帮可莉解决麻烦！就用这串「可莉烤鱼」来报答你吧！——呃，其实鱼是直接在湖里就被炸弹烤熟了，不过这件事就和平时一样，假装不知道好了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Thanks for helping me out every time I get in trouble! I have a thank-you present for you — barbecued fish, made with my own secret recipe! ...Okay, so the secret recipe is exploding the fish out of the water. Tee-hee, they're fully cooked by the time they land! But it's a secret, right, so you don't get to tell anybody. Just pretend like you don't even know.

items.title: 可莉的爱好
items.text: 可莉喜欢毛茸茸的东西。比如嘟嘟可、蒲公英，还有雷泽的头发。
items.text_en: I like things that are fluffy~! Like Dodoco! And dandelions! And Razor's hair!

items.title: 可莉的烦恼
items.text: 唉，你是好人，我是坏孩子…等我这次的禁闭结束、好好反省过以后，再来找你带我出去玩…
items.text_en: *sigh* You're a good person, but I'm a bad girl. Once I'm out of solitary confinement and am done reflecting on my actions, we can go play together again, okay?

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 蒙德的鲈鱼是很好吃的，从果酒湖里抓到的尤其好吃！这可不是瞎说的，连妈妈也认同可莉的想法喔。
items.text_en: Mondstadt's basses are delicious, especially the ones you grab yourself from Cider Lake! I'm not even kidding, even my mom thinks so.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 讨厌蒙德蟹——什么蟹都讨厌——可莉要出去玩——不要坐在餐桌前慢慢剥壳——
items.text_en: I hate, hate, hate Mondstadt's crabs! All of them! I wanna go out and play, I don't wanna just sit there tryna de-shell a crab all day...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 好香好香！可莉已经吃到吃不下啦…
items.text_en: Yummy, yummy! Oof, I'm so full...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 今天也吃到了好吃的东西，可莉好开心！谢谢你！
items.text_en: Yay, I got to eat something tasty today. I'm so happy! Thank you!

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 看上去很好吃，但吃起来不太方便…嘿嘿，你来帮帮可莉好不好！
items.text_en: It looks yummy, but it's kinda hard work to eat... Hee-hee, how about you help me? Pretty please!

items.title: 生日
items.text: 生日快乐！过生日很开心，你比可莉大，那过生日的次数一定比可莉多吧？可莉很羡慕！
items.text_en: ♪Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you, happy birthday dear Traveler, happy birthday to you!♪ You're older than me right? That means you've had way more birthdays than me... I'm sooo jealous!

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 嗯，新型炸弹研究完毕！趁琴团长发现之前，开溜！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1Mm, new-bomb research complete! Now, let's get outta here before Jean finds out...

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 又进步了一点！不过琴团长总是说：「进步是分内之事。」
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2Aw yeah, I improved again! But as Jean says, "Continuous self-improvement is one's duty." She says that means I'm allowed to be a bit happy about it, but not the most happy I've ever been in my whole life about it.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 谢谢你总是陪我一起收集研究用的材料！如果你想学习炸弹的制作方法，我也可以来教你哦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4Thanks for helping me gather so much stuff for my research! If you ever wanna learn how to make a bomb, I can teach you y'know.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 很久以前，第一次听到爆炸声的时候，我没有害怕…后来我才知道，大部分人不是这样的…不过，你也不害怕我的炸弹呢！嘿嘿，太好了，可莉果然交到了很好的朋友！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6I remember the first time I ever heard an explosion... I wasn't scared at all. Later on, I found out that apparently, that's not "normal," and most people would've been scared. But hey, you're not scared of my bombs right? Tee-hee, I knew it! That's why your my bestest friend ever!

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 蹦蹦炸弹！
items.text_en: Jumpy Dumpty go!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 弹起来吧！
items.text_en: Boing, boing, boom!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 嘿咻！
items.text_en: Pieew.

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 轰轰火花！
items.text_en: Sparks 'n' Splash!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 火力全开！
items.text_en: Blazing Delight!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 全——都可以炸完！
items.text_en: Blow them aaaalll up!

items.title: 冲刺开始·其一
items.text: 啦啦啦~
items.text_en: Lalala~

items.title: 冲刺开始·其二
items.text: 哒哒哒~
items.text_en: Da-da-da~

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 可莉又找到新的宝物了！
items.text_en: More treasure, more treasure! Hee-hee...

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 亮闪闪的，好开心！
items.text_en: Yay, shiny!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 地下会不会埋着更多宝箱呢…
items.text_en: Maybe there's even more buried below...

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 哇…怎么会这样…
items.text_en: What did you do that for!?

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 琴团长…它欺负我…
items.text_en: Jeeeean... they're picking on me!

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 玩累了，有点晕…
items.text_en: I feel kinda woozy...

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 火花骑士，爆破支援！
items.text_en: I can make a big bang if you want!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 你不要紧吧？
items.text_en: Are you okay?

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 看我成功开溜…！啊，失败了。
items.text_en: Yay, I did it! Oh wait, no I didn't...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 可莉…想回家了…
items.text_en: I wanna go home now...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 又闯祸了…
items.text_en: It was an accident...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 过分…
items.text_en: No fair!

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 好疼啊！
items.text_en: That really hurt!

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 可莉来帮忙！
items.text_en: Klee can help!

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 锵锵——可莉登场。
items.text_en: Ta-da! Klee is here!

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 好耶！是大冒险。
items.text_en: Yea! Let's go on a big adventure!
